description: This file defines operations for managing an array of object IDs ('oid_array'), including appending, sorting, looking up, clearing, iterating, filtering, and handling uniqueness of object IDs in the context of a Git-like repository.

methods.name: void oid_array_append(struct oid_array * array,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Appends a new object ID to the array, setting its algorithm if not already set, and marks the array as unsorted.

methods.name: void oid_array_sort(struct oid_array * array)
methods.description: Sorts the array of object IDs if not already sorted, using a custom quicksort based on hash comparison.

methods.name: int oid_array_lookup(struct oid_array * array,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up the position of a given object ID within the array, sorting it first if necessary.

methods.name: void oid_array_clear(struct oid_array * array)
methods.description: Clears the entire array, freeing memory and resetting counters.

methods.name: int oid_array_for_each(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn fn,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID in the array, applying a callback function.

methods.name: int oid_array_for_each_unique(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn fn,void * data)
methods.description: Iterates over each unique object ID in the array, applying a callback function.

methods.name: void oid_array_filter(struct oid_array * array,for_each_oid_fn want,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Filters the object IDs based on a predicate callback, removing those that do not satisfy the condition.

methods.name: const struct object_id * oid_access(size_t index,const void * table)
int void_hashcmp(const void * va,const void * vb)

ctags.name: oid_access
ctags.pattern: /^static const struct object_id *oid_access(size_t index, const void *table)$/
